events.name: IAMWATCH 2026
events.note: Thu Nov 12 is invitation only. Dress code: "Double-Wristed, Resort Casual."

events.name: Golden Hour Singapore
events.note: Free entry; walk-ins welcome. The first 100 people through the doors each day get an exclusive Delugs tote bag. By appointment: Artime, Dominique Renaud and Renaud Tixier on Friday, Nov 13; Stéphane Pierre on Saturday, Nov 14 — book via their cards. On display: Fleming, Grönefeld, J.N. Shapiro, Kallinich Claeys, Romain Gauthier and Simon Brette.

events.name: Spring Sprang Sprung 2026
events.note: Two Chat-Time talks: Art Meets Horology (Sat, Nov 14) and How Do You Build a Great Microbrand? (Sun, Nov 15) — both may be sold out. Two paid hands-on workshops run before doors open: Watchmaking Appreciation with WOSTEP-certified watchmaker Alvin Sim (Sat, Nov 14, 10 AM–1 PM, SGD 180, tools provided) and Watch Art by eight.past.ten, sketching and calligraphy with framed art to take home (Sun, Nov 15, 10–11 AM, SGD 30).

events.name: Phillips — Hong Kong auction highlights in Singapore
events.note: See selected highlights from the upcoming Hong Kong watch auction. Enquiries: christinefernando@phillips.com.

brands.name: La Fabrique du Temps Louis Vuitton

releases.text:
Monday Skeleton — The Monday, fully openworked: the new RVI2025 caliber puts all 262 hand-finished components on view, including the patented "dancer" platinum micro-rotor winding system and 238 hand-finished inward angles. The 40.8mm gray-gold case comes in petrol blue or green editions, each limited to 15 pieces.
Price: CHF 129,000 excluding taxes

A2 — Anoma's upcoming A2 was first teased on November 3, 2026, when the brand announced an exclusive preview of the watch at Golden Hour in Hong Kong on November 7–8, 2026, ahead of its official launch later in November.

Inflection Shuò — A 40mm case and integrated bracelet in pure tantalum, with a solid 18k gold dial finished by hand tremblage — Massena LAB's blue-filled Arabic numerals paired with hand-calligraphed Chinese numerals, by Coralie Mercier for GT Cadrans. Inside is a customized Girard-Perregaux GP03300. Two variants, White Gold and Rose Gold, 50 pieces in total.
Price: CHF 33,800 excluding taxes ($44,100)
Availability: Sold out.

Teaser — A brand-new Baltic line, teased October 22 with color and texture as its stated focus.

Hermétique The Rift — A limited edition of the Hermétique field watch tied to The Rift gravel race in Iceland, and the first Hermétique offered in a smaller 34mm size alongside the 37mm. Fully luminous white dial with a forged carbon track and Icelandic landscape colors; Miyota 9039.
Price: €620 excluding taxes (€744 including VAT)
Availability: Sold out in both 34mm and 37mm.

Aquascaphe GMT MK-II — The second-generation Aquascaphe GMT switches to a Miyota 9075 true traveler GMT with a jumping local hour. The redesigned 39.5mm case adds crown guards and doubles water resistance to 200m; four sapphire-bezel color options.
Price: €850 on rubber strap / €915 on steel bracelet, excluding taxes

Antarctique Tourbillon "Victory Green" — A 40.5mm Antarctique in 18k yellow gold with a forest-green hand-guilloché dial — the brand's "Singularité" pattern by Metalem — and the in-house Calibre 9 flying tourbillon. It began as a bespoke collector commission.
Price: CHF 69,600 on rubber / CHF 73,600 on alligator / CHF 98,000 on a gold bracelet, before taxes.
Availability: Limited to 10 numbered pieces; through authorized retailers and the brand.

ALD Checker — Dennison turns its ALD case into a checkerboard: polished black onyx and pavé VS2 diamonds in alternating quadrants, with a diamond-set bezel, in a 37 × 33.5mm black PVD steel case with a Ronda quartz movement. Three compositions — Checker Balance, Checker Draw and Checker Gambit.
Price: £6,300 ($7,900)

Summit MK2 — Dune Devil, Glade & Après-Bleu — Earthen's 38mm Summit MK2 field watch gets its first colored ceramic cases: beige Dune Devil with a brown dial, dark green Glade with a full-lume mint dial, and navy Après-Bleu with cream-colored markers. All three run the Miyota 9039 automatic and come with two FKM rubber straps.
Price: $899 excluding VAT

Essence Ceramica Dark Matter "Redshift" — The Essence in a 41mm black ceramic case with a near-black meteorite dial and red accents. The Sellita SW200-2 "Power+" movement is COSC-certified with a 65-hour reserve.
Price: CHF 3,500 / $4,450.
Availability: Limited annual batches of 100 pieces; first deliveries end of November 2026.

Teaser — Two new Formex models have been teased for Golden Hour Singapore. The watches' identities, specifications and designs have not been disclosed ahead of the fair.
Availability: To be unveiled at Golden Hour Singapore.

Teaser — Holthinrichs will present unreleased work at Golden Hour Singapore alongside its Signature Ornament and Ornament Nouveau models.
Availability: To be unveiled at Golden Hour Singapore.

Kubo Momiji — Kiwame Tokyo adds the Momiji to its Kubo series, with a glossy Koimomiji-red lacquer dial and a raised maple leaf inside the recessed small-seconds display at 4:30. The 37mm steel case (9.3mm thick, 45mm lug-to-lug, vertically brushed flat bezel, 30m) houses a Miyota 82S5 automatic with a 42-hour reserve, on a quick-release Italian calf leather strap.
Price: $630 (excluding taxes)
Availability: Pre-orders open Tue Nov 17, 2026, 9:00 AM JST; delivery from January 2027.

Royal Smith 90-006 80 hrs — Kuoe's first dial with Roman numerals, in 35mm and 39mm sizes with Ivory, Blue and Green dials. The Miyota Cal. 9085 automatic gives an 80-hour power reserve — Kuoe is the only Japanese brand with early access to the caliber.
Price: $990.
Availability: Pre-orders open; shipping from February 2027. Initial allocation 1,000 pieces.

Royal Smith 90-010 Auto, Golden Hour Editions (Ivory x Grainy Dial / Panda x Grainy Dial) — Two Golden Hour editions of the Royal Smith 90-010 Auto, 10 pieces each: Ivory x Grainy Dial and Panda x Grainy Dial, each with day and month sub-dials and a date window. The Ivory edition adds blued steel hands for the seconds and sub-dials. A special medallion on the caseback carries the Delugs logo alongside Kuoe's. A choice of navy sailcloth or dark gray alcantara strap.
Availability: On sale November 13–15, 2026.

F77 MKII 100 Years — Marking a century of the brand, the F77 MKII 100 Years rebuilds the 1970s integrated-bracelet sports watch around natural stone dials — Jade, Shungite Black, Labradorite, Azurite, Smoky Quartz and Black Opal — in a 38mm steel case. Inside is a new La Joux-Perret G101 automatic with a 68-hour reserve, visible through a sapphire back.
Price: $1,590 on strap / $1,790 on bracelet (€1,660 / €1,870)
Availability: The first batch sold out on the brand's US store, with restock signalled ("inventory on the way").

Colorama — Nivada Grenchen revives the Colorama, a 1965 model, as the brand's first collection for women. The 17mm steel case, 6.75mm thick, carries a white enamel dial and a Ronda quartz movement, with click-on interchangeable bezels. It is sold in four sets, each with leather straps and a heart pendant; the two Collector sets add a second pendant and seven straps.
Price: $695 / $895 (Collector sets)
Availability: On sale November 19, 2026.

Vessel — A new American microbrand's first watch: a 39mm case in 904L steel with a Sellita SW300-1, in Sunray and Meteorite dial versions, each limited to 150 pieces. Wren shows at Golden Hour Singapore in November.
Price: $2,900 (Sunray) / $3,400 (Meteorite).
Availability: Pre-order for delivery in Q1 2027. The Meteorite version is sold out; the Sunray version (pictured) is available.

Malachite Vinyl – Ando x Zeromark – Limited Edition — A Vinyl Record edition with a dial of genuine malachite stone, in the model's 41mm case with a Seiko VH31 high-beat quartz movement. The caseback is engraved with peacock feathers. Limited to 30 pieces.
Price: $437

Inflection Shuò — A 40mm case and integrated bracelet in pure tantalum, with a solid 18k gold dial finished by hand tremblage — Massena LAB's blue-filled Arabic numerals paired with hand-calligraphed Chinese numerals, by Coralie Mercier for GT Cadrans. Inside is a customized Girard-Perregaux GP03300. Two variants, White Gold and Rose Gold, 50 pieces in total.
Price: CHF 33,800 excluding taxes ($44,100)
Availability: Sold out.

Sơn Mài – Frosted Leaf "Blood Moon", "Storm" and "Lagoon" — Three new dials join Awake's Sơn Mài Frosted Leaf line: handcrafted Vietnamese lacquer over silver leaf, in red, teal and copper-orange. The 38mm steel case houses a La Joux-Perret G101 automatic. Around 100 pieces per color are made each year.
Price: €2,820 including taxes

Teaser — Awake teased a reimagined version of its signature Sơn Mài lacquer-dial watch on November 6, 2026. The full reveal is set for November 9, 2026.

Type 3X — Benrus's first completely new design in over 50 years: a 42mm case mixing titanium and carbon-fiber composite, with an ETA 2893 automatic GMT movement and 200m water resistance. Offered in black/tan and green.
Price: $2,950

Nouvelle — Buci's second collection: a 36mm steel dress watch with a blotting-paper-textured dial, hand-painted calligraphic numerals and small seconds at 9, driven by a hand-wound Sellita movement. The launch edition is 300 numbered pieces.
Price: €1,550
Availability: Pre-order via Kickstarter until Nov 15, 2026.

Space Explorer — Canuck's first Signature model: a 39mm tonneau steel case with a two-piece aviation dial whose 12 o'clock marker is a radiant maple leaf in place of the usual triangle. Inside is a hand-wound Seagull ST1700; the three colorways — Deep Orbit Black, Cathode Ray Green and Nebula Velvet Purple — are numbered, 75 pieces in total, and each watch ships with both an FKM strap and an elastic metal bracelet.
Price: C$650 (approx. $478)

C1 Loco Classic — The Loco Classic takes Christopher Ward's suspended-balance Loco into a classic register: a white ceramic Roman-numeral subdial and exposed free-sprung balance in a 41mm steel case. Its hand-wound CW-003 caliber runs for 144 hours; the Gold version is a 2026 GPHG Petite Aiguille nominee.
Price: £4,295 ($5,995) on suede strap; £4,495 ($6,275) on Consort bracelet

Sealander Yalos Automatic — A slimmer, dressier Sealander in a 39mm steel case, with a stamped, lacquered dial in Ice Blue, Salt Pink, Sand White or Sea Green. A COSC-certified Sellita SW300-1 automatic sits inside.
Price: £1,290 ($1,815) on Vesuvio suede strap; £1,495 ($2,095) on Consort bracelet

C1 Jump Hour XV — A 15th-anniversary reimagining of the C9 Harrison Jumping Hour, with a rhodium-silver guilloché dial, Roman-numeral hour window and blue PVD minute hand in a 39mm steel case. The refined JJ01 automatic jump-hour module marks each hour with an instantaneous jump.
Price: $2,495 on Consort bracelet
Availability: Sold out; manufacturer waitlist open for any pieces that become available. Limited edition of 300 pieces.

Time Cipher Gold — A gold-toned edition of CIGA Design's Time Cipher, joining the existing black steel model in the line. Black-coated 316L steel case, 44mm, with the in-house CD-08 automatic and a skeletonised dial.
Price: $899 excl. tax (€949 incl. VAT).

Destinations GMT — Constellar Timepieces teased an all-new Destinations GMT collection on November 5, 2026, ahead of its launch at Spring Sprang Sprung in Singapore on November 14, 2026.
Availability: Launching at Spring Sprang Sprung, Singapore, November 14, 2026.

Nexus — Erebus's third model: a 38.5mm integrated-bracelet sports watch with ten dial variants, from fumé and mother-of-pearl to jade, carnelian and lapis lazuli. Miyota 9015 or Sellita SW200-1 Premium.
Price: From $599 (pre-order, Miyota 9015) / $799 (Sellita SW200-1 Premium).

Bio Bay Terrazzo — A new Bio Bay model with a terrazzo-inspired dial: 39mm steel case with fixed lugs, a Miyota quartz movement, sapphire crystal and 100m water resistance.
Price: $175
Availability: Delivery estimated early December 2026.

Pilbara MK2 Dive Watch — The second-generation Pilbara diver: 41mm steel, a Miyota 9015 automatic — now with the date at 6 — a ceramic bezel insert, 200m water resistance and a quick-adjust clasp. Four dial colors.
Price: A$875
Availability: Delivery December 2026.

Isotope × Direnzo — DRZ 08 Cosmonaire GMT — Isotope's edition of the DRZ 08 Cosmonaire, Direnzo's new first GMT: a gray layered dial with heat-blued hands in the model's 39mm coated-steel case with an elliptical bezel; Sellita SW330-2. One of the Cosmonaire's two limited editions, alongside a 60-piece meteorite version.
Price: CHF 1,350 at launch / CHF 1,400 retail
Availability: Launches Sat Nov 21, 2026, 15:00 CET; delivery mid-January 2027; 40 pieces.

Flyway Coral — A new colorway of the Flyway: a coral dial stamped with a pyramid pattern in a 36mm wing-shaped steel case, under a hyperbolic paraboloid sapphire crystal — a saddle-shaped geometry that keeps the dial distortion-free and legible from a wide range of angles. A choice of Landeron or La Joux-Perret G101 automatics; 100 pieces.
Price: £1,200 (Landeron) / £1,496 (La Joux-Perret G101)

Master Carbon SEAL Chronograph Automatic (3880 Series) — The first automatic chronograph in the Master Carbon SEAL line: a 45mm CARBONOX+ case with a Sellita SW500 automatic chronograph movement, day-date, 200m water resistance and 16 tritium light tubes.
Price: $3,195

P-38 Lightning 9520 Series GMT — The P-38 Lightning returns in a new generation: a 42mm steel case with a black IP finish, sapphire crystal and a Ronda quartz GMT movement, in three dials — Black Stealth, Sandstorm and Open Skies Blue.
Price: $675

Yang (Minim × L'Artisan) — A first-anniversary collaboration with Belgium's L'Artisan: a genuine rhodonite center dial and sub-seconds framed by a mother-of-pearl outer ring carrying Minim's Chinese numerals, in a 38mm steel case with a micro-rotor automatic movement, on a gray suede strap with pink stitching. Limited to 40 pieces.
Price: €1,049.49
Availability: Sold out.

F77 MKII 100 Years — Marking a century of the brand, the F77 MKII 100 Years rebuilds the 1970s integrated-bracelet sports watch around natural stone dials — Jade, Shungite Black, Labradorite, Azurite, Smoky Quartz and Black Opal — in a 38mm steel case. Inside is a new La Joux-Perret G101 automatic with a 68-hour reserve, visible through a sapphire back.
Price: $1,590 on strap / $1,790 on bracelet (€1,660 / €1,870)
Availability: The first batch sold out on the brand's US store, with restock signalled ("inventory on the way").

Colorama — Nivada Grenchen revives the Colorama, a 1965 model, as the brand's first collection for women. The 17mm steel case, 6.75mm thick, carries a white enamel dial and a Ronda quartz movement, with click-on interchangeable bezels. It is sold in four sets, each with leather straps and a heart pendant; the two Collector sets add a second pendant and seven straps.
Price: $695 / $895 (Collector sets)
Availability: On sale November 19, 2026.

Teaser — OAN.GIO teased a new 38mm collection on November 6, 2026 — a platform reimagined from the ground up rather than a smaller version of its 40mm model, opening more room for the brand's artistic dial work. The first models will be unveiled at Spring Sprang Sprung in Singapore on November 14–15, 2026.

ProPilot Calibre 111 (redesigned) — A redesigned ProPilot Calibre 111 in a slimmer 43mm case, with black or pine green textured dials. The hand-wound in-house Calibre 111 gives a 10-day (240-hour) reserve with a non-linear indicator, and a date at 6.
Price: CHF 5,900 on Cordovan strap / CHF 6,100 on bracelet ($7,200 / $7,400).

Big Crown Pointer Date × Cervo Volante Burgundy — The latest Cervo Volante collaboration puts the vintage-inspired Big Crown — fluted bezel, cathedral hands — in an autumnal burgundy gradient dial, on a dark brown deer-hide strap from the Swiss leather specialist. The 40mm steel case runs the Oris 754 automatic, with a 41-hour reserve.
Price: CHF 2,250 ($2,600)

Big Crown Pointer Date Oxblood — A new oxblood-red dial colorway for the contemporary Big Crown Pointer Date. The 40mm steel case has a smooth bezel, pencil hands and an arrow-tipped pointer date, on an H-link bracelet. Inside is the Oris 754 automatic, based on the Sellita SW200-1, with a 41-hour reserve.
Price: CHF 2,000 ($2,400)

Forma Venti Albus and Forma Venti Rosé — Two new colorways of the Art Deco Forma Venti jumping-hour: a matte white Albus and a wine-inspired Rosé, each with color-matched hour, minute and seconds discs over a CNC-guilloché Double Delta dial. The 30.5 × 32mm steel case houses a Seagull ST1721 automatic.
Price: €780 each

Freelancer Calibre RW1212 Anthracite Skeleton, 40mm — The RW1212 skeleton in a new 40mm size, between the line's 42mm and 38mm models. An anthracite openworked dial shows the balance wheel at 6 and the open barrel at 11; the RW1212 automatic is Raymond Weil's caliber developed with Sellita.
Price: £3,495 on bracelet / £3,395 on leather ($3,850 / $3,795).

Toccata Classic 24mm — A new 24mm size for the Toccata Classic, in single-tone gold: rose gold or yellow gold PVD across the case, bracelet and sunray dial. The quartz case is 5.1mm thick, with a non-date display and 50 meters of water resistance.
Price: $1,375

Freelancer Complete Calendar — Raymond Weil introduced a new anthracite gray colorway of the Freelancer Complete Calendar on November 5, 2026. The 40mm steel watch pairs an anthracite sunray dial with a matching calf leather strap and carries the RW3281 automatic movement, which displays the day, date, month and moon phase.
Price: £3,495

Originate · Fangyu Collection — A 38mm square steel case inspired by the architecture around Shanghai's Bund City Hall Plaza, with an ST2130 automatic movement and exhibition caseback. Four dials — green, white, gray and burgundy — on Alcantara straps; the burgundy version comes in a rose-gold-tone case.
Price: RM 3,286

Expedition — The first model in Straum's new "Built For" line: a hardened, bead-blasted Grade 5 titanium case (38.2mm bezel diameter) with a stepped bezel and a glove-sized crown, in three dials including a fully luminous white. La Joux-Perret G100; pre-orders open, shipping March 2027.
Price: 31,000 kr on FKM rubber / 35,000 kr on titanium bracelet (including Norwegian VAT)
Availability: Pre-order from Aug 24, 2026; shipping March 2027. Midnight Blue is limited to 200 pieces.

Futurist Tantalum Edition — A 39mm × 10mm angular tantalum case with a dark, bluish-gray luster, seven sunburst dial colorways and a faceted sapphire crystal. The Miyota 9039 automatic runs for more than 40 hours; water resistance is 100m, with a RIOS cordovan leather strap.
Price: $2,999.
Availability: No more than 30 pieces worldwide, with five or fewer per colorway. A prototype will be shown at Spring Sprang Sprung; allocations open by expression of interest after the Singapore exhibition, rather than standard store checkout.

Teaser — Vario teased a new watch on November 5, 2026 — its smallest yet, built around the Miyota 6T33 hand-wound movement — with a prototype on show at Spring Sprang Sprung in Singapore.
Availability: Prototype on show at Spring Sprang Sprung, Singapore, November 14–15, 2026.

1941 Quadrivium — A new model in the 40mm 1941 case, in tantalum or platinum, 28 pieces of each. The hand-wound Calibre G-09 combines a 7.5-second remontoire, a one-minute flying tourbillon, a central jumping seconds and a power-reserve indicator.
Price: S$473,100 (Tantalum) / S$523,800 (Platinum), including GST

Teaser — Trilobe has teased a new watch created for IAMWATCH, to be unveiled during the Singapore fair. No model name, specifications or images have been released ahead of the reveal.
Availability: Unveiled at IAMWATCH, Nov 13–15, 2026.

S8 — Garrick's smaller answer to the 42mm S3: a skeletonised, open-worked watch with no conventional dial, so the hand-bevelled, black-polished movement is the face. The 39mm case comes in platinum, steel, or gold, with a modified in-house caliber and subsidiary seconds at 8 o'clock. The full reveal is in person at IAMWATCH.
Availability: Full reveal at IAMWATCH, Singapore.

Takashi Murakami — Takashi Murakami's own watchmaking venture, Time Objects, will be unveiled at IAMWATCH in Singapore. Nothing of the watches themselves has been shown ahead of the fair.
Availability: Unveiled at IAMWATCH, Singapore, November 12–15, 2026.

Laureato Fifty Three Gold Bridges — The Laureato Fifty Three Gold Bridges joins the permanent collection as the steel version of 2025's limited edition, now with rose gold accents. The openworked GP9620 in the 41mm case runs three rose gold Neo Bridges, a platinum micro-rotor at 12 o'clock, and a tourbillon at 6, with a 55-hour reserve.
Price: CHF 162,000 ($182,000)
Teaser — MING has a new watch on the way, teased in the brand's October newsletter: "Our next watch arrives in a few weeks — we're dressing up for the occasion."

Futur Antérieur (Louis Erard × Vianney Halter) — Louis Erard's third collaboration with Vianney Halter channels his 1998 Antiqua prototype: two raised, riveted porthole sub-dials set diagonally in a 38mm steel case, in gold-tone or silver-tone versions. Two Sellita SW100 automatics run the watch — one for the hours and minutes, one for the small seconds.
Price: CHF 4,950; CHF 9,900 for a set of both

Marqueterie de Paille — A Métiers d'Art piece in straw: Portuguese artist Bernardo d'Orey hand-builds each "Broken Ice" dial from 28 sections of rye straw in layered blues, about two days of work per dial. The 39mm steel case houses a Sellita SW261-1 automatic. Limited to 25 pieces.
Price: CHF 4,500

Unfrogettable — Turquoise / Brown (Louis Erard × Konstantin Chaykin) — The frog-eyed regulator returns in two new colorways: Turquoise, bright and electric, and Brown, warm and earthy with 5N-treated discs and crown. The 40mm Grade 5 titanium case runs a Sellita SW266-1 automatic, on black Himeji Kurozan leather. Each colorway is limited to 178 pieces.
Price: CHF 4,500

releases.brand: La Fabrique du Temps Louis Vuitton
releases.text:
Tambour Convergence Mirror Steel — The Tambour Convergence, Louis Vuitton's dragging-disc watch under an arched window, now comes in mirror steel: a 37mm case in hardened steel, hand-polished to a mirror finish. The rhodium-treated brass discs match the cold tone of the case, and the in-house LFT MA01.01 automatic gives 45 hours of reserve.
Price: €26,000 ($25,200)

MONTAR Collection — The full reveal of the MONTAR collection teased in October 2026. The MONTAR GMT pairs a 43mm polycarbonate case and a Ronda quartz GMT movement with a rotating 24-hour bezel — a first batch of 200 — and the MONTAR Ana-Digi sets analog hands over a digital display in a 44mm steel case. Both are water resistant to 100 meters, and pre-orders ship in early December 2026.
Price: $275

Souscription — The first watch from French watchmaker Mickaël Gaspar, teased in November 2026 ahead of its full reveal at IAMWATCH in Singapore on November 12, 2026. His own movement, a decade in development, puts a retrograde date and the movement on the dial side, above a moving dial. About twenty pieces are planned, made and delivered by Gaspar.

Royal Smith 90-010 — A Delugs-exclusive limited edition of Kuoe's Royal Smith 90-010, created for Golden Hour Singapore: 20 pieces with a custom Delugs medallion on the case back, bundled with a bracelet and a Delugs strap instead of the standard bracelet and leather strap. Kuoe watchmaker Roy announced the edition in Golden Hour's November 1, 2026 reel, ahead of the fair's November 13 opening.
